text:
Maria: Morning — async handoff for the tiny slice rollout of feature-flag ld/fast-path-v3. Warmup completed on pool-a, initial traffic opened. Quick updates: what I did / blockers / today.

Aj: saw a small bump in p95 on pool-a during warmup (~120ms -> 210ms). not huge but worth watching. pasted a quick metric snippet.
```
2026-03-17T09:02Z pool-a p50=40ms p95=210ms error_rate=0.2%
2026-03-17T09:04Z pool-a p95=190ms error_rate=0.3%
```

InfraBot: deploy-job-4721 triggered for ld/fast-path-v3 on pool-a (txn id d3f2). warming replicas: 4 -> 8.

Kevin: pushed PR #1289 that tweaks KV TTL from 30s -> 60s for tiny-slice to reduce cold-evict thrash. needs one more +1. link: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/1289

Lisa: quick heads-up — memory alarm threshold still at default on pool-a. if kv TTL change doesn't land we might see OOM churn. can someone bump threshold or add swap guard?

Sam: I can review the PR in ~45m. @Maria can you paste the repro command you used for the cold-start test so I can run locally?

Maria: repro curl is below — use header X-Redwood-Slice: tiny-a for correct routing.
```bash
curl -sS -H "X-Redwood-Slice: tiny-a" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup-check","max_tokens":8}'
```

Aj: thanks — after running a couple of loops I see a GC spike correlated with first requests. probable cause: aggressive mem reclaim combined with small batch sizes.

Maria: current plan: hold ramp at 0.5% until PR merged + one warmup cycle completes. rollback criteria: error_rate > 1% sustained for 3 minutes OR p95 > 250ms for 5 minutes. escalating to on-call if either triggers.

Kevin: acked and added test for mem pressure in the PR. also added a small logging stub for KV evictions.

Lisa: I'll temporarily raise memory alarm on pool-a by 10% and monitor for 30m.

Sam: reviewed the PR, left one nit about a comment. will approve after that.

InfraBot: job 4721 update: 4/8 replicas warmed, health=passing (8/8) for service: fast-path-v3.

Maria: great — once PR is merged I'll update the rollout sheet and nudge infra to proceed to 2% if everything is green. ping me here if you hit anything odd. :thumbsup:

Aj: posting a quick note in the ops channel if alarms spike.

Maria: thanks team — cc @eng-sre for visibility.
